summary: Validated trilingual CMS sync: (1) cross-language image slot identity is perfect — ES/EN/FR program page yield 67 IDENTICAL [data-cms-image-slot] ids all prefixed 'viajes.norte.tanger_fez.programa_5n_6d.*'; (2) POST /api/translate ES→EN/FR works (200, real translations, empty/whitespace returns {}, source==target returns {}); (3) existing CMS endpoints (GET /api/slots, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/text_slots[?lang], GET /api/cms/export) all 200; (4) E2E autotranslation flow verified — toggled header-text-edit-toggle on /, typed 'Aventura inolvidable por Marruecos PRUEBA85103' into editable-text-home.hero.eyebrow, blurred, then via /api/text_slots?lang=… confirmed the SAME slot id stores {es: ES phrase, en: 'UNFORGETTABLE ADVENTURE IN MOROCCO TEST85103', fr: 'AVENTURE INOUBLIABLE PAR MAROC TEST85103'} and /fr renders the FR translation. 10/10 backend tests pass.

test_results.translate_endpoint: PASS — POST /api/translate returns real LLM translations; empty/whitespace and source-in-targets both return {translations:{}}; status 200 for all 3 cases
test_results.cross_language_image_slots: PASS — ES (/viajes/norte/tanger_fez/programa_5n_6d) / EN (/en/tours/northern/tangier-fez/program-5n-6d) / FR (/fr/voyages/nord/tanger-fes/programme-5n-6j) all expose exactly 67 [data-cms-image-slot] attributes; sets identical (ES==EN, ES==FR); every id starts with 'viajes.norte.tanger_fez.programa_5n_6d.'
test_results.autotranslation_e2e: PASS — Edited ES hero eyebrow → after blur (~6s wait) the same slot id home.hero.eyebrow stored ES=typed phrase, EN+FR auto-translated by LLM. /fr DOM rendered the FR translation in the eyebrow position. Edit mode toggle and navigation lockdown observed correctly.
test_results.rendering_check: PASS — /fr loaded with localized hero ('Voyages sur mesure à travers le Maroc') and the new auto-translated eyebrow text visible in the page.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/translate: relies on emergentintegrations LlmChat with gpt-4o-mini and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (configured). Empty/whitespace + source==targets both short-circuit to {} — good.
EditableText.save runs translate only when lang==='es' — correct per design. If translate API fails the ES write still persists (best-effort fan-out) — verified non-fatal.
slotScope.normalisePathname() correctly canonicalises localized routes to the ES slug, producing language-independent slot ids. Verified empirically by the 67-slot identity check.

Header editable items (e.g. header.nav_menu) also get translated when edited in ES — same mechanism. Side effect during testing: clicking 'editable-text-header.nav_menu' opens the side menu (because the Menu button is the same DOM region). The Menu's overlay then blocks subsequent typing on body content. Not a bug, just a testing-ergonomics note — header editable items should be edited carefully or via direct focus.

API GET /api/text_slots?lang=… still returns the full multilingual payload per slot (es/en/fr keys inside each entry) — the ?lang param appears to be advisory; effective filtering happens client-side. Acceptable; no behaviour issue.
test_credentials: None used — public toggles. Admin password 'xaluca' available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but not needed.
seed_data_creation: During E2E: temporarily wrote home.hero.eyebrow (es/en/fr) and header.nav_menu. Both cleaned up afterwards via PUT 'Xaluca Tours' on hero.eyebrow and DELETE on header.nav_menu — verified slots now fall back to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cross-language slot identity uses the ES canonical slug as the slot key for ALL languages. To verify autotranslation: enable header-text-edit-toggle, edit any editable-text-* in body area (avoid header.nav_menu — its container opens the side menu and intercepts clicks), type a unique ES phrase, blur (NOT navigate, edit mode blocks navigation). After ~5-8s the translate API populates en+fr on the same slot id. The text_slots endpoint stores all 3 langs inside one record; ?lang filter is advisory. To restore a slot to default, DELETE /api/text_slots/{slot_id} (no lang param) removes overrides for all langs.
